propositions: Comment identity must be keyed by local HLC timestamp and persisted Jira comment ID, not by normalized body text, to avoid collisions and edits appearing as new comments.

Returned Jira comment IDs from add_comment must be captured at both enactment sites (create_one and update_one via handle_update/_apply_outbound_update) and persisted immediately via record_comment_id write-ahead save.
Comment sync is append-only: new comments mirror once; edits and deletes are never pushed to Jira or applied from Jira, guarded by mapped key or jira_comment_id presence.

Outbound comment bodies must render through RichTextCodec.to_wire (AdfCodec for Cloud, WikiTextCodec for DC), with fit-then-encode ordering and _resolve_codec migrated from _IdentityCodec to the real codec for correct dedup.

Inbound-origin jira_comment_id and outbound map are each authoritative for their direction; inbound differ remains unchanged, outbound differs on mapped key or jira_comment_id presence, avoiding double-sync.
After codec migration, comment-diff must converge without duplicates, remain idempotent on repeat reconciles, and recover durably from crashes between add_comment success and map save completion.
